title: lava armor and lava tools
description: this mod allows you to use cool lava armor and lava tools
body:
🔥 Lava Armor and Lava Tools Mod 🔥  
Wield the power of molten fury!

Descend into the depths of Minecraft's most dangerous realms with the Lava Armor and Lava Tools Mod, a blazing upgrade to your endgame gear! Forge powerful armor and tools infused with the essence of lava, giving you unmatched strength, durability, and control over fire and flame.

🔥 Features:-  
🛡️ Lava Armor Set  
⚒️ Lava Tools (Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel,  
🌋 Custom Crafting Recipes  
Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.4 | neoforge exlusive   edit(thanks to you guys for trying my mod more mods are on the way!!)
